verdict.rationale: The evidence says source connections 'automatically sync data' and that syncs can be triggered from external Pipedream workflows. Neither documents a way for the user to schedule recurring jobs in Airweave itself: there is no cron, interval or sync-schedule configuration. Automatic syncing is an adjacent behavior, and Pipedream-triggered syncs are a one-off action driven by a host platform, not a recurring schedule owned by the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
